show.description: When a war hero returns from the dead, he discovers a world where power, money, and betrayal collide. Battlefield to Billionaire follows Major Vikram Rathore’s journey from the frontlines to the empire he once lost — a tale of love, revenge, and rising again in a world driven by greed and glory.
